title: A year ago ReactWise did one thing: it told you which experiment to run next. Now we support the CMC pipeline from the first plate to scale-up readiness.
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
A year ago ReactWise did one thing: it told you which experiment to run next. Now we support the CMC pipeline from the first plate to scale-up readiness.


We rebuilt the site this week, mostly because that one-line description had stopped being encompassing.


What’s there now, roughly in the order a campaign moves through it:


**HTE Designer.** Hit screening for medicinal chemistry and process HTE in one place. General reaction conditions proposed across a substrate set, arranged into a layout a liquid handler can execute, with stock solutions calculated and worklists generated for the most common instruments.


**MemoryBO.** Optimization that doesn’t start from zero. It learns from your previous campaigns, and through ZeroShotAPI it draws on models pretrained on data from our own lab - including the failed conditions that never reach a paper.


**Solvent Selector.** Greener alternatives identified while there’s still time to act on them, which is before scale-up rather than during it.


**Kinetics360.** First-principles kinetic models built from your time-series data. Mechanisms, orders, and rate parameters you can interrogate, and simulations of conditions you haven’t run.
